=== PAGE BREAK ===
DEMO GROUP HEALTH SHIELD - POLICY WORDING (Version 2)
WAITING PERIODS AND TIME CLAUSES

A. Pre-existing Diseases (Code-Excl01)
Pre-existing diseases of Dependent Parents are excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage. This waiting period is waived for Employees and their Spouses from day one.

B. Specified Disease/Procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
The following listed conditions, surgeries and treatments are excluded until the expiry of the waiting period shown in the Certificate: Cataract; Hernia; Hysterectomy; Kidney stones; Gall bladder stones; Joint replacement surgery unless necessitated by accident.
Waiting period variations: the specified disease waiting period is waived for Employees and their Spouses, and is 12 months for Dependent Parents.

C. Maternity
Maternity expenses are covered from day one. Maternity waiting period under this Group Policy: Nil.

D. Counting of Waiting Periods
The waiting periods are counted from the Date of First Enrolment of each Insured Person under this group, as shown in the Certificate.

E. Relapse
A relapse of the same illness within 45 days from the date of discharge shall be treated as part of the same illness for the purposes of the limits and conditions of this Policy.
